text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, this is kinda embarrassing. Thanks, 
for the present and everything.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You better be grateful and take this! I'm 
the one who tracked it down for ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that mug was super stylish. The red 
and blue with white stripes looked really 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's one thing I'm wondering 
about. Why did it come as a pair? Like a 
backup in case one breaks?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To toast with my friends, of course! You 
can't make a toast with just one, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah? What's your problem, got a complaint?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, not quite. I just wanted to know 
which shop you bought this mug from.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Without one more, the three of us can't 
toast together, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
City...! Ahaha, you're right! Let's raise 
our matching mugs to friendship!
